race.comment: FEISTY TIGER (3) recorded a strong performance last time when she battled on bravely to just miss out over 1700m at this track. No excuses from this advantageous draw. Tackles a similar assignment and she can grab a win. RIP ROCK (10) finished fifth at Bathurst two runs ago before finishing fifth at his latest appearance over 2260m at Bathurst, beaten 14 metres. Hard to know where he gets from this slightly awkward draw. Tackles a similar assignment and he can turn in a much better performance. LOCHINVAR COOGEE (8) is heading the right way, improving last time out to finish third at Young over 1720m. Genuine threat. ULTIMATE COOKIE (1) should not have any excuses from the favourable draw.
